ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Required 64-character hex key used to encrypt sensitive Yurucommu data. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

AUTH_PASSWORD_HASH.description: Required password credential for a direct Cloudflare install. Use a PBKDF2 salt:hash value or a strong one-time bootstrap secret.

YURUCOMMU_SESSION_HASH_SALT.description: Required high-entropy session hash salt. Generate with openssl rand -hex 32, supply as a Worker secret, and preserve the exact value across updates.
